name: qa-wrap-bridge
description: Read-only MCP server that lets a coding agent read the test sessions recorded in QA Wrap. Local only, no network.
long_description: QA Wrap bridge reads the sessions recorded by the QA Wrap browser extension through Chrome native messaging. It has four read-only tools, no write tool and opens no network connection. One-time setup: run `npx qa-wrap-bridge` in a terminal, then turn on Agent bridge in QA Wrap's Settings.

tools.name: list_sessions
tools.description: List the sessions on this machine, newest first.

tools.name: get_session
tools.description: Return one session in the qawrap.session/1 format (newest if no id).

tools.name: get_failures
tools.description: Return only the failures of a session, duplicates folded with a count.

tools.name: get_ai_brief
tools.description: Return the compact plain-text block that Copy for AI produces.
